title: DOGE Veterans Are Landing Big Jobs at Prediction Markets
summary: Elie Mishory, a former CFTC regulator who helped develop the agency’s framework for prediction markets, worked as Kalshi’s general counsel and chief regulatory officer in 2025 before stepping down to lead DOGE’s efforts at the SEC, where he worked with Mendelson.
